title: The Cradle of Stars
synopsis: The epic series finale. Armed with decoded pre-collapse navigation keys, Leo and Astrid lead the free fleet on a return voyage to the forbidden Sol system. They uncover the ancient truth behind humanity's fall and execute one final, daring relativistic slingshot maneuver around Jupiter's gravity well to break the Dominion's ultimate super-dreadnought, inaugurating a new golden dawn of freedom.

chapters.title: The Dead Star System
chapters.summary: Emerging in the Sol system; the eerie, silent cemetery of humanity's ancient expansion.

chapters.title: Ruins of the Orbital Ring
chapters.summary: Passing through the shattered remnants of Mars's orbital elevator and docking rings.

chapters.title: The Truth of the Collapse
chapters.summary: Recovering the orbital archives of Luna: the Dominion was born from the military junta that quarantined Earth.

chapters.title: The Earth Below
chapters.summary: Leo gazes down upon his home planet for the first time in 1,000 years: oceans green and wild, scars of old wars healed.

chapters.title: Hawke's Grand Armada
chapters.summary: The Dominion's supreme dreadnought 'The Archon-Imperator' arrives with its battlefleet.

chapters.title: The Battle for Humanity's Cradle
chapters.summary: The largest vacuum fleet battle in history commences between Earth and the Moon.

chapters.title: Railgun Salvos and Plasma Storms
chapters.summary: Capital ships colliding; silent detonations turning the blackness into midday.

chapters.title: The Marauder's Sacrifice
chapters.summary: The Starlight Marauder takes critical damage protecting the allied fleet's carrier.

chapters.title: Transfer to Chronos-1
chapters.summary: Leo's original ship, refitted by Orlo with modern ordnance, becomes their last spearhead.

chapters.title: Astrid and Leo in the Cockpit
chapters.summary: Flying together in the tandem cockpit of the Chronos-1; complete synchronization.

chapters.title: The Jovian Maneuver
chapters.summary: Hawke retreats toward Jupiter's massive radiation belts, daring them to follow.

chapters.title: Into the Radiation Belts
chapters.summary: High-radiation transit past Io and Europa; shields screaming at the limit.

chapters.title: The Hyperbolic Slingshot
chapters.summary: Leo proposes one final relativistic slingshot around Jupiter's gravity well to out-speed the dreadnought.

chapters.title: Crushing G-Forces
chapters.summary: 14-G deceleration burn; holding hands through the agony of the gravitational plunge.

chapters.title: The Blind Flank
chapters.summary: Emerging from Jupiter's shadow at 0.15c, completely bypassing the dreadnought's forward shields.

chapters.title: Spinal Kill
chapters.summary: Chronos-1 fires an antimatter-tipped kinetic penetrator directly into the dreadnought's fusion core.

chapters.title: The Fall of the Archon
chapters.summary: The dreadnought shatters in a blinding silent nova; Dominion forces surrender.

chapters.title: Setting Foot on Earth
chapters.summary: Leo and Astrid's shuttle touches down on a lush, wild beach on the coast of ancient North America.

chapters.title: The Smell of Rain
chapters.summary: Leo steps out into real air, real wind, and real sunlight; sharing the first breath with Astrid.

chapters.title: A New Dawn
chapters.summary: Founding a new, free colony under the stars where freedom and science thrive together.
